gif-maker.q1: How do I make a GIF from pictures?
gif-maker.a1: Drop two or more pictures, put them in order with the arrows, pick a delay per frame and press Make GIF. The preview plays at the delay you chose. Download saves the GIF.
gif-maker.q2: Can I turn a video into a GIF?
gif-maker.a2: Yes. Drop one video your browser can play (MP4, WebM, and MOV in Safari), set the start and end in seconds and the frame rate, then press Make GIF. Keep clips short: 300 frames is the limit, for example 30 seconds at 10 frames per second.
gif-maker.q3: Why is my GIF file so big?
gif-maker.a3: GIF stores every frame with at most 256 colours and compresses poorly compared with video. Make it smaller with a narrower width, fewer frames per second, a shorter clip, fewer colours or dithering off.
gif-maker.a4: It mixes nearby palette colours in a fine pattern so gradients and photos look smooth instead of banded. It usually makes the file a little bigger. Turn it off for flat graphics and screenshots.
gif-maker.q5: Is anything uploaded? Is there a watermark?
gif-maker.a5: No and no. Frames are drawn and encoded in this tab, so your pictures and videos never leave the device, and the GIF has no watermark.

image-splitter.q1: How do I split a picture into a 9-post grid for Instagram?
image-splitter.a1: Drop the picture and choose 3 × 3 Instagram grid. Its tiles are 3:4, the shape Instagram's profile grid shows, so the nine posts line up with no gaps; the centre is cropped to fit. Press Split, then download the ZIP or each tile.
image-splitter.q2: In what order do I post the tiles?
image-splitter.a2: Instagram puts the newest post first, top left, so post the last tile first. Tick Show posting order to number the tiles that way: post 1, then 2, up to the last.
image-splitter.q3: Can I split a panorama into a swipeable carousel?
image-splitter.a3: Yes. Choose 1 × 3 carousel (or set 1 row and as many columns as you want). Its slides are square; pick Whole picture under Tile shape to keep the full height.
image-splitter.a4: PNG tiles are copied pixel for pixel. JPG and WebP are re-encoded at high quality, which keeps files smaller. The tiles are never scaled up or down.
image-splitter.a5: No. The picture is cut in this tab and the tiles are made on your device.

area.q1: How do I find the area of a rectangle?
area.a1: Multiply length by width. A room 5 m long and 3 m wide has an area of 15 m². Pick Rectangle, type both sizes and the calculator shows the area, the perimeter and the working.
area.q2: What is the formula for the area of a circle?
area.a2: A = π × r², where r is the radius (half the diameter). A circle with a 2 cm radius has an area of about 12.566 cm².
area.q3: How do I find the area of a triangle without the height?
area.a3: Choose Triangle (three sides). It uses Heron's formula: with p = (a + b + c) / 2, A = √(p(p − a)(p − b)(p − c)). A 3-4-5 triangle has an area of 6.
area.q4: How do I convert square metres to square feet or acres?
area.a4: The result is listed in every common unit. 1 m² is about 10.764 ft²; one acre is 43,560 ft² (about 4,046.86 m²); one hectare is 10,000 m².
area.q5: Why is there no perimeter for some shapes?
area.a5: A triangle from base and height, a trapezoid and a parallelogram can have many different side lengths with the same area, so the perimeter is not fixed by those inputs.

volume.q1: How do I calculate the volume of a box?
volume.a1: Multiply length × width × height. A box 30 × 20 × 10 cm holds 6,000 cm³, which is 6 litres.
volume.q2: What is the volume of a cylinder?
volume.a2: V = π × r² × h. A can with a 4 cm radius and 10 cm height holds about 502.65 cm³, or half a litre.
volume.q3: How do I convert cubic centimetres to litres or gallons?
volume.a3: 1,000 cm³ is 1 litre and 1 cm³ is 1 mL. A US gallon is 3.785 litres (231 in³) and an imperial gallon is 4.546 litres. Every result is listed in those units.
volume.q4: What is the volume of a sphere?
volume.a4: V = 4/3 × π × r³. A ball with a 3 cm radius has a volume of about 113.1 cm³ and a surface area of about 113.1 cm² (the two numbers match only at r = 3).
volume.q5: Is the ellipsoid surface area exact?
volume.a5: No. There is no simple exact formula, so the calculator uses Knud Thomsen's approximation, within about 1% for any ellipsoid, and marks it with ≈. The volume is exact.

random-letter.q1: How do I pick a random letter?
random-letter.a1: Press Draw. Each of the 26 letters is equally likely. Draw again for a new one; the last ten draws are listed below.
random-letter.q2: Can I draw only vowels or only consonants?
random-letter.a2: Yes. Set Letters to Vowels (A E I O U) or Consonants. Add letters to Leave out, for example Q X Z for a word game.
random-letter.q3: How do I get several letters with no repeats?
random-letter.a3: Set How many and tick No repeats. Up to the whole alphabet can be drawn that way, which also gives you the letters in a random order.
random-letter.a4: Each draw uses the browser's cryptographic random generator (Web Crypto) with rejection sampling, so no letter is favoured.
random-letter.a5: English A–Z, Spanish with Ñ, the 29-letter Vietnamese alphabet, Greek, Russian (33 letters), and Japanese hiragana and katakana (46 basic kana).

gif-maker.lead: Make an animated GIF from pictures or a short video in three steps. Nothing is uploaded.
gif-maker.s1b: Drop two or more pictures (each is one frame) or one video clip. Reorder pictures with the arrows.
gif-maker.s2b: For pictures pick the delay per frame; for a video set Start, End and frames per second. Choose the width, repeat and colours.
gif-maker.s3b: Press Make GIF, watch the result play, then Download GIF. Smaller width or fewer frames give a smaller file.

image-splitter.lead: Cut a picture into equal tiles for an Instagram grid or carousel. Nothing is uploaded.
image-splitter.s1b: Drop, choose or paste one picture. The grid is drawn on top of it at once.
image-splitter.s2b: Pick a preset such as 3 × 3 Instagram grid or set rows and columns. Tile shape crops the centre to 3:4 (Instagram grid) or square tiles, or keeps the whole picture.
image-splitter.s3b: Press Split, then Download ZIP or tap single tiles. Show posting order numbers them for Instagram, last tile first.

area.lead: Find the area and perimeter of a shape in three steps.
area.s1b: Choose from 12 shapes and the unit your sizes are in. The formula appears under the menus.
area.s2b: Fill in each field. The answer updates as you type; a message says if a size is missing or impossible.
area.s3b: See the area, the perimeter where it is fixed, each step of the working and the area in m², ft², acres and more.

volume.lead: Find the volume and surface area of a solid in three steps.
volume.s1b: Choose from 12 solids and the unit your sizes are in. The formula appears under the menus.
volume.s2b: Fill in each field, all in the same unit. The answer updates as you type.
volume.s3b: See the volume, the surface area, the working and the volume in litres, gallons, cups and cubic units.

random-letter.lead: Draw random letters in three steps.
random-letter.s1b: Pick the alphabet, all letters or only vowels or consonants, and the case. Leave out any letters you do not want.
random-letter.s2b: Set How many and tick No repeats if each letter may come up only once.
random-letter.s3b: Press Draw. The letters appear large; Copy puts them on the clipboard and the last ten draws are listed.

job.title: SVG to PNG
job.lede: SVG is drawn from shapes, so it can be made into a PNG at any size. Pick 2× or 4× for sharp icons and logos on high-density screens. Transparency stays in PNG.

faq.q1: How do I convert SVG to PNG?
faq.a1: Drop the SVG, choose the SVG size (1× is its own size) and download the PNG. Several files download as a ZIP. Nothing is uploaded.
faq.q2: How do I get a high-resolution PNG from an SVG?
faq.a2: Set SVG size to 2×, 3× or 4×. The drawing is redrawn at that size from its shapes, so edges stay sharp instead of blurring. The longest edge is capped at 8,192 px.
faq.q3: Does the PNG keep a transparent background?
faq.a3: Yes. Parts of the SVG with nothing drawn stay transparent in the PNG. JPG would fill them with a colour.
faq.q4: Why are fonts or pictures missing from my PNG?
faq.a4: Browsers draw an SVG file in isolation: fonts that are not installed and pictures linked from other files or sites are left out. Convert text to outlines and embed pictures before exporting.
faq.q5: What size is the PNG at 1×?
faq.a5: The SVG's width and height. If it only has a viewBox, its width and height are used; with neither, browsers use 300 × 150.
